selection: two author-train cases in lexicographic order among neck-thorax-abdomen-pelvis; no model results used
surface_method: RAS canonical CT; axial HU>-500, 2-pixel binary opening, largest 2D component, hole filling; first occupied voxel along anterior-positive axis
target_definitions: vertebral label centroid projected posteriorly at its X/Z
mean of posterior-most 2 percent labeled voxels projected at its X/Z
target_scope: CT label-derived surface proxies; neither physician palpation nor acupoint ground truth
boundary_checks: label occupancy and scanner-boundary contact; surface body coverage; raw CT axial/sagittal visual inspection
label_input_separation: body surface extraction uses CT only; bone labels used solely to define diagnostic targets and qualification
pose_domain: CT acquisition pose is not inferred to be prone; supine support/contact differs from deployment
